question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing cheerleader, and Claire is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Finally, Claire and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) cheerleader
(C) right winger
solution:
Position order in every row: (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (left midfielder, cheerleader, right winger)
1. Bob ↔ Claire: (left midfielder, right winger, cheerleader)
2. Alice ↔ Bob: (right winger, left midfielder, cheerleader)
3. Claire ↔ Alice: (cheerleader, left midfielder, right winger)
Alice is playing cheerleader, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
